events.name: O Christmas Tea: A British Comedy
events.info: Fans of Monty Python, Mr. Bean, and Dr. Seuss... Grab your teacups! Combining British propriety with an unabashed love for the unexpected, London's 3-time Impresario Award-winning duo steep an outrageously funny and brilliantly inventive show reminiscent of classic British pantos. Rich in wordplay, comic physicality, and cleverly crafted interactive elements, O Christmas Tea is uproarious fun, yet it is the duo's boundless imagination and endearing chemistry that provide the real magic and heart of this play. "Complete and utter fun for all ages." Five Stars, CBC "Outrageously funny, magnificently written, beautifully choreographed." Five Stars, London Free Press "An ode to the idea that anything is possible." Five Stars, Torontoist "I cannot think of a show that will leave you more profoundly happy than this." Five Stars, Stage Door Visit OChristmasTea.com for the full 60-city tour!
events.pleaseNote: If the cost is beyond your means, we invite you to select the Subsidized Ticket option. No babes in arms, minimum age of 4.
